children: Greek retail sales by volume rose 1.9% in June, statistics service ELSTAT said on Monday.

Sales volume of the food sector was up 2.5% year-on-year, with the sales volume of the non-food sector (except automotive fuel) increasing 4.0% while the automotive fuel sector's sales volume was down 6.9% on the year, the data showed.
